name: Appy Pie
description_en:
Appy Pie’s app builder turns a prompt into an app that can be refined with visual controls and built-in modules. This profile concerns its mobile app-building path rather than treating the separate automation, design and agent products as one subscription.

Adoption depends on the selected mobile platform, per-app subscription and release responsibilities. A generated preview is only the start: signed builds, store listings, privacy information and approval remain part of launch work. Official pages also differ on how much submission assistance is included, which needs resolution for the chosen plan.
description_zh:
Appy Pie 应用构建器从提示词生成应用，再通过可视化控制和内置模块调整。本说明聚焦移动应用构建路径，不将独立自动化、设计和智能体产品视为同一订阅。

采用时需考虑目标移动平台、按应用订阅及发布责任。生成预览只是起点，签名构建、商店页面、隐私资料和审核仍属于上线工作。官方不同页面对提交协助范围的描述也有差异，需按所选方案核对。

core_features.explanation_en: Create an initial app from a description, then revise screens and enabled modules visually.
core_features.explanation_zh: 先通过描述创建初始应用，再可视化修改屏幕及启用的模块。

core_features.explanation_en: Basic and Gold target Android, while Platinum adds the Apple platform.
core_features.explanation_zh: Basic 和 Gold 面向 Android，Platinum 增加 Apple 平台。

en: Evaluate a small Android app with a complete navigation path.
Compare Android-only and dual-platform release requirements.
zh: 评估有完整导航路径的小型 Android 应用。
比较仅 Android 与双平台发布的要求。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose the platform and verify current regional price, download allowance and submission-support scope.
steps.zh: 选择平台，核对当前地区价格、下载额度及提交支持范围。

steps.en: Use non-sensitive content and test the real build; review trial renewal before entering payment details.
steps.zh: 使用非敏感内容测试真实构建，填写付款信息前查看试用续订规则。

items.en: A free trial is not sustained free commercial publication.
items.zh: 免费试用不等于持续免费商业发布。

items.en: Publication assistance does not guarantee approval.
items.zh: 发布协助不保证审核通过。

pricing.summary_en: The official pricing page lists paid Basic, Gold, Platinum and Enterprise options plus a seven-day personal/non-commercial trial. The regional page did not expose a reliable numeric checkout total. Platform scope, download caps and submission assistance must be confirmed together; store-account costs are separate.
pricing.summary_zh: 官方价格页列出 Basic、Gold、Platinum、Enterprise 付费选项及七天个人／非商业试用。地区页面未返回可靠的数字结账总额。需一起核对平台范围、下载上限及提交协助，商店账户费用另计。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Separate the app builder from the product family
sections.title_zh: 区分构建器与产品家族
sections.en: The homepage describes app generation and visual refinement; the terms separately describe AppMakr, Website Builder, Automate and other products. Select the actual app-building subscription and needed modules rather than assuming a family-wide feature entitlement. Test one complete user journey with representative content.
sections.zh: 首页描述应用生成与可视化调整，条款则分别说明 AppMakr、Website Builder、Automate 等产品。应选择实际应用构建订阅及所需模块，不能假定家族产品功能通用。用代表性内容测试一条完整用户路径。

sections.title_en: Treat the store release as a separate workflow
sections.title_zh: 将商店发布作为独立流程
sections.en: The release guide separates builder-generated files from the owner’s developer accounts, listing materials and privacy responses. Appy Pie creates the Android AAB and supports the iOS path on Platinum. Keep account ownership and release materials under review; the builder cannot approve an app on a store’s behalf.
sections.zh: 发布指南区分构建器生成文件与所有者的开发者账户、商店资料和隐私回答。Appy Pie 生成 Android AAB，并在 Platinum 提供 iOS 路径。需核对账户归属和发布资料，构建器不能代表商店批准应用。

sections.title_en: Test the build that will be submitted
sections.en: The publication guide calls for installing the real build, checking cold launch and navigating every screen. Use that as an evaluation task rather than assuming that a prompt-generated preview proves device behavior. Its update process requires a new build with a higher version number and another store submission.
sections.zh: 发布指南要求安装真实构建、检查冷启动并访问每个屏幕。应将这些作为评估任务，不能认为提示词预览证明了设备行为。文档的更新流程需要更高版本号的新构建及再次提交商店。

sections.title_en: Budget around platform and usage caps
sections.title_zh: 按平台及用量上限预算
sections.en: The pricing page gives Basic, Gold and Platinum different platform and download allowances: 500, 1,000 and 2,000 monthly downloads respectively in the read page. These are separate from claims of unlimited hosting or editing. Confirm the intended region, billing cadence and overage handling instead of carrying forward a directory’s old starting price.
sections.zh: 已读价格页为 Basic、Gold、Platinum 列出不同平台及下载额度，每月分别为 500、1,000、2,000 次。额度与不限托管或编辑的宣传是不同事项。应核对地区、计费周期及超量处理，不沿用目录旧起价。

sections.title_zh: 核实提交协助措辞差异
sections.en: The pricing page describes first-time submission support on lower plans, while the current publication guide assigns full submission help to Platinum and self-submission to Basic/Gold. Do not assume either statement grants a particular service; ask for the current written scope when purchasing that assistance.
sections.zh: 价格页在较低方案写有首次提交支持，当前发布指南则将完整提交协助列为 Platinum，Basic／Gold 自行提交。不能据其中一句推定某项服务已包含，购买协助时需取得当前书面范围。

sections.title_en: A trial becomes a billing obligation
sections.en: The terms describe a seven-day trial requiring payment details and automatic paid conversion on day eight unless canceled. Paid subscriptions renew until cancellation; non-payment can lock editing and viewing. Record a cancellation and continuity plan before trialing a business-critical app. This describes the published terms, not a refund or billing action performed here.
sections.zh: 条款说明七天试用需要付款资料，未取消会在第八天自动转付费。付费订阅持续续订，未付款可能锁定编辑和查看。试用关键业务应用前应记录取消及服务延续方案。这里只描述公开条款，未执行退款或账单操作。
